data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and whenever stock is 500. If all 25 comply, we earn $10,000 each and leave 250 tons, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome. I'll request 10 this month. Please state whether you'll join; revealed catches will show compliance. Sustainable restraint can yield far more over time than a one-month race.
